title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin climbs 1.3 percent to sixty-three thousand eight hundred forty-two dollars while fear and greed sits at twenty-three, extreme fear. US morning action shows steady buying into the dip without conviction.

Hashrate holds at eight hundred nineteen point nine exahashes per second. Mempool congestion reaches one hundred thousand transactions yet fees remain low at five sat per vbyte, signaling limited urgency from users. Block height advances to nine hundred fifty-seven thousand four hundred
